extraction.Name: Mortimer Clifford
extraction.Refused/Protested: I accepted it with protest but I understood it was compulsury.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: This land was taken for security on a bunch of cattle bought and the cattle did not pay out. but did not receive any actual money.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farming and lobor, the Government or state has not contributed to my support.
extraction.NOTES: Has kidney trouble; took bankruptcy and is financially broke; wife and six children dependent upon him; states he has not been defrauded of his property according to law; mortgage was foreclosed and date of redemption has expired; County of Washington, State of South Dakota; allotment 480 acres also referenced (480/12° notation); deponent signed with X mark
